profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineering Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the consumer services industry. Skilled in Embedded Software, Device Drivers, C++, Software Development, and ARM Architecture. Strong engineering professional with a Master of engineering focused in Computer Science from , University of Technology of HoChiMinh City.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: - Develop SW features for router devices to support ISP clients.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: - Develop the IoT solution and IoT devices

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Develop the security camera system with battery power for the smart home base on OV798 chip
- Develop the IoT bridge device support many wireless interfaces as Z-Wave, Zigbee, Wifi and Bluetooth base on OpenWRT rootfs and Alljoyn platform base on TI Sitara AM335X chip
- Develop Z-Wave Bluetooth bridge for pressure and temperature sensors base on ARM Cortex-M0 chip

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Bring up reference design for the router, the access point with PowerPC company chip
- Bring up reference design for the server with ARM64 bit company chip
- Develop Eclipse plugin for ARM64 chip
- Customize buildroot, openWRT file systems
- Porting Android for embedded system

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester
positions.description: Support to test and check the quality of company products.

positions.title: Technical Solution
positions.description:
- Training Telecommunication about 3G, LTE: Building document and training courses for new employees
- Maintaining and developing CHRM component in Call-Processing of nodeB: CHRM (channel resource management) is a part of BTS call processing to manage the resources and measurement
- Developing the algorithm for updating MIB/SB1 to insert SIB19 at nodeB for Cell Reselection feature(LTE): Implement the new algorithm for nodeB to support LTE device when switching BTS
- Designing Dual Cell feature(HSPA+) for CHRM, RRM(Radio Resources Measurement) and 
 CCC(Common Channel Controller) components: Dual cell purposes to improve the bandwidth at downlink site by increasing 2 cells support at the downlink site
- Improving RRM by restructuring and implement new testing environment: Implement a new way to measurement and build new testing environment to support new measurement

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designing and implementation Test card GUI software: Designing form to set up and configure test card for generating errors or simulated situations so that testing EP4848 evaluation board. Coding and test with HW
- Designing and implementation EMS(Element Management System) software: Designing an application to control EP4848 equipment as configuration, monitoring fault, and performance of EP4848 equipment. Coding and test one simulation system with 2 nodes
- Designing and implementation Application on Linux support EP4848 evaluation board: Designing application to manage the operation of the EP4848 chip on EP4848 evaluation board as configuration, management defects, failures and performance on system and report failures and alarm when occurs. Coding and test with EP4848 evaluation board
- Designing and Implementation Data Link Controller (DLK) Device Driver: This module includes the core API of data link controller to support configuration and processing messages
- Designing and implementation SONET/SDH API device driver: Designing API to configure and control SONET/SDH and STE module on AT4848. Coding and test with the EP4848 evaluation board
- Designing SONET/SDH API device driver for EUROPA chip: Designing API to configure and control SONET/SDH module on EUROPA
- Designing DLK API device driver for EUROPA chip: Designing API to configure and control DLK module on EUROPA

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designing form to control and manage time sheet, salary, projects, and information about the employees in company. 
Set up environment like OS, DBMS and framework for application
